title: InstantiateMsg
description: InstantiateMsg defines the message used to initialize the contract.

consensus_data_valid_period.description: Initial valid period for data in seconds.

data_delta_ppm.description: Delta in percent per million (ppm), for which two values are considered equal

jlp_token.description: The address of the JLP token used in AUM calculations. Must be specified in the required_solana_balances along with strategy_address.

owner.description: The address that will be the contract's owner.

price_data_valid_period.description: How many blocks we consider BTC/USD price from oracle as valid.

required_custody_assets.description: List of custody asset denoms required for consensus

required_solana_balances.description: List of solana addresses (key) which balances of assets (value) are required for consensus. Must contain jlp_token balance tracking for the strategy_address.

required_solana_token_total_supply.description: List of solana tokens which total supply is required for consensus

solana_slinky_map.description: Map of Solana asset names to Slinky oracle asset names for price lookups

strategy_address.description: The address of the strategy contract used in AUM calculations. Must be specified in the required_solana_balances along with jlp_token.
